context.label: Hope, dispute, and earlier language

observations.body: A mother and her sons endure torture; the second and fourth brothers speak of receiving life again and being raised by God.
observations.label: Seven brothers face death with a stated hope

observations.body: The passage presents Enduring torture as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Enduring torture

observations.body: The passage places Raised again beside Enduring torture.
observations.label: Raised again

payload.posture: Read 2 Maccabees 7:1–14 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a mother and her sons endure torture; the second and fourth brothers speak of receiving life again and being raised by God. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
payload.title: Seven brothers face death with a stated hope
